During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Waskiro colony|colony]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Waskiro/Legends|Waskiro]] was '''wiped out''' by combat [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of an unknown make. The few survivors were unable to identify the attackers' allegiance when the Republic came to investigate why the colony had gone silent.<ref name="Fate" />
